frames.title: Eat stew
frames.description: Front-right three-quarter, seated on a simple low wooden stool, eating stew from a wooden bowl with a spoon. Walking stick leans safely against stool.

frames.title: Eat bread
frames.description: Front-left view, seated holding a piece of bread in one hand and bowl in lap, taking a small bite. Same stool and clothing.

frames.title: Laugh seated
frames.description: Front-right view, seated on stool laughing warmly, mouth open, eyes crinkled, one hand on belly and other on knee. No food in hands.

frames.title: Laugh and gesture
frames.description: Left-side view, seated chuckling with head tipped back slightly and hand raised, walking stick beside stool.

frames.title: Inspect pickaxe in lap
frames.description: Front-right view, seated carefully inspecting an old pickaxe laid ACROSS his lap; one hand touches iron head and other holds handle.

frames.title: Examine pickaxe crack
frames.description: Front-left view, seated pointing at a crack in the pickaxe head on a small low table while holding its handle. He is examining, never swinging or mining.

note: Character and work props are composed together. These six scenes are independent static references, not an animation loop.
